softwareInnerHero.title: Design with Confidence
paragraphs: Our Structural Engineering Software provides comprehensive tools for analysis, design, and documentation of building structures. From high-rise buildings to bridges, industrial facilities to residential projects, our software helps engineers create safe, efficient, and innovative structural designs.

At Aptus Infotech, we provide industry-leading structural engineering software solutions along with expert training and support to help engineering firms in Oman deliver exceptional projects with confidence.

cardSections.subheading: Discover the capabilities that make our Structural Engineering Software essential for modern design

items.title: Advanced Analysis
items.body: Perform linear and nonlinear static and dynamic analysis with powerful finite element solvers. Analyze complex structures under various loading conditions including seismic, wind, and thermal effects.

items.title: 3D Modeling
items.body: Create detailed 3D structural models with intuitive modeling tools. Generate complex geometries, define material properties, and apply loads and constraints with precision.

items.title: Design Optimization
items.body: Optimize structural elements for material efficiency and performance. Automatically size members, check against design codes, and generate cost-effective solutions.

items.title: Comprehensive Documentation
items.body: Generate detailed calculation reports, construction drawings, and material takeoffs. Automate documentation workflows to save time and reduce errors.

items.title: International Design Codes
items.body: Stay compliant with global design standards including ACI, AISC, Eurocodes, BS, and Omani building codes. Easily switch between codes for international projects.

items.title: BIM Integration
items.body: Seamlessly integrate with BIM workflows through interoperability with Revit, AutoCAD, and other design software. Exchange data efficiently across project teams.
